Thirteen people were booked into the Webb County Jail on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds, according to Webb County booking records covering Tuesday, October 27, 2026. Each person is listed below with the charge shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

## CASTILLO, JUAN GERARDO

**CASTILLO, JUAN GERARDO** was booked on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, at 12:11 a.m. on an alleged federal violation. No bond had been set at the time of booking; the person is being held by the United States Marshals, and the arresting agency was listed as Homeland Security.

## GARZA-HERNANDEZ, RAMIRO

**GARZA-HERNANDEZ, RAMIRO** was arrested on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, at 1:13 a.m. by the Laredo Police Department on an alleged Class B misdemeanor charge of harassment. No bond had been set at the time of booking.

## MARTINEZ, GUADALUPE, JR

**MARTINEZ, GUADALUPE, JR** was arrested on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, at 1:56 a.m. by the Department of Public Safety on an alleged Class B misdemeanor charge of possession of marijuana under 2 ounces. No bond had been set at the time of booking.

## LARA-MALDONADO, MANUEL

**LARA-MALDONADO, MANUEL** was booked on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, at 2:04 a.m. on an alleged federal violation. No bond had been set at the time of booking; the person is being held on an immigration hold, and the arresting agency was listed as Customs and Border Protection.

## RUIZ, CARLOS EDUARDO

**RUIZ, CARLOS EDUARDO** was arrested on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, at 6:38 a.m. by the Laredo Police Department on alleged Class A misdemeanor charges of assault causing bodily injury to a family member and interference with an emergency request for assistance. No bond had been set at the time of booking.

## CORONADO, JAVIER, JR

**CORONADO, JAVIER, JR** was arrested on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, at 7:06 a.m. by the Laredo Police Department on an alleged Class B misdemeanor charge of criminal mischief valued at $100 to under $750. No bond had been set at the time of booking.

## JAIMES, DAVID

**JAIMES, DAVID** was arrested on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, at 7:47 a.m. on an alleged Class B misdemeanor charge of possession of marijuana under 2 ounces. No bond had been set at the time of booking; the arresting agency was not listed in the record.

## OJEDA, GERARDO ALFREDO, JR

**OJEDA, GERARDO ALFREDO, JR** was arrested on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, at 7:55 a.m. on an alleged Class B misdemeanor charge of silent or abusive call or electronic communication to 911 service and an alleged Class A misdemeanor charge of evading arrest or detention. No bond had been set at the time of booking; the arresting agency was not listed in the record.

## GAMBOA, BRANDON

**GAMBOA, BRANDON** was arrested on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, at 11:17 a.m. by the Laredo Police Department on alleged Class A misdemeanor charges of terroristic threat of family or household and assault causing bodily injury to a family member. Bond was set at $10,000 on one charge and $15,000 on the other.

## HOGAN, EDWARD

**HOGAN, EDWARD** was arrested on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, at 3:14 p.m. by the Webb County Sheriff's Office on alleged charges of assault causing bodily injury in a family-violence case, a Class A misdemeanor, reckless driving, a Class B misdemeanor, and driving while intoxicated, a Class B misdemeanor. No bond had been set at the time of booking.

## LOPEZ, BRITTANY SAMANTHA

**LOPEZ, BRITTANY SAMANTHA** was arrested on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, at 3:49 p.m. on an alleged Class B misdemeanor charge of driving while intoxicated. No bond had been set at the time of booking; the arresting agency was not listed in the record.

## ESTEVEZ, NELSON

**ESTEVEZ, NELSON** was arrested on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, at 5:33 p.m. by the Laredo Police Department on an alleged Class A misdemeanor charge of organized retail theft valued at $100 to under $750. Bond was set at $5,000.

## HERNANDEZ, JORGE ALFREDO

**HERNANDEZ, JORGE ALFREDO** was booked on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, at 10:46 p.m. on an alleged federal violation. No bond had been set at the time of booking; the person is being held by the United States Marshals, and the arresting agency was listed as the Laredo Police Department.
